# Embedded Time Maker

Source from markstevengray95-star/time-maker, commit 6241b866dc1d201e71af0d341eb0f2529c39d6a5 (phases 1–20).
The CPD host owns authentication, school selection, saves, staff account links and publication.
The same-origin iframe isolates the builder's styles and uses an origin/source-checked message bridge.
It receives no Supabase credentials. `npm run build:timetable` regenerates public/time-maker.
Portal account creation is replaced by existing CPD school accounts; draft data never directly updates staff planners.
